test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 1 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is: **'on'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"on that flight"** correctly implies being a passenger of or involved with the flight in question.
 
• It suggests a physical presence within the space of the vehicle or mode of transport.
 
• **"On"** is commonly used with vehicles, including planes, to denote being aboard or part of the journey.
 
 
• Example: The new famous rapper on **on**__ our flight.
 
 
 
• In contrast to other prepositions, **"on"** specifically aligns with the context of flights, highlighting both presence and participation.

Therefore, the correct sentence is: *She is not the only one __**on **__that flight, since there was also a flight attendant who kept checking on people.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

__
 
• **"In" **can be used to denote being inside or within something but is less specific than "on" when referring to being part of a flight.
 
• **"Over"** suggests a position above or across something but does not accurately describe being a passenger on a flight.
 
• **"At" **indicates a location or presence in a certain place but lacks the specificity of being aboard a flight that "on" provides.

 

Correct Paragraph:__ *Connie Sellecca plays first officer Mimi Thompkins who manages successfully to land Flight 243 after its roof is ripped (1) __off__ mid-flight due to mental fatigue. She is not the only one **(2) __on__ **that flight, since there was also a flight attendant who kept checking on people. And telling them they were going to be fine (3)__________ they had giant pieces of aeroplane carpet stuck to their heads. I can’t (4)_________ land a plane or tell the wounded people that they would be fine soon, due to the fact that I would be (5)_________ too hard and throwing out what ever food I had throughout the day. *
